summary: Full backend + frontend testing of MARCEL Indicator Catalog module (149 indicators, 4 scopes, 24 auto-computed). 14/14 backend tests pass. Frontend UI verified: catalog page (149 rows, search/filters/expandable rows), portfolio panel (11 P1 cards, selector modal, detail modal), project detail 'Indicateurs' tab, program detail 'Indicateurs' tab, dashboard 'Mes indicateurs' section without regression on existing widgets. Non-regression on /pb and /roadmap OK.

testid_naming_deviation.impact: cosmetic — automated tests need to know the actual testid

action_items: Optional: rename data-testid 'catalogue-prio-filter' → 'catalogue-priority-filter' and 'catalogue-comp-filter' → 'catalogue-computability-filter' to match the spec (or update spec). Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend PUT /api/indicator-catalog/selections/{scope} correctly filters invalid IDs (verified: FAKE-999/NOT-REAL rejected).
Dashboard selection is per-user (admin & pmo have independent selections — verified).
Portfolio preset-p1 returns 11 P1 indicators including GOU-01/GOU-04/PLA-05/PLA-06/RIS-01/RIS-12/SAF-09 as expected.
GET values/project without context_id returns 400 as expected.
seed_data_creation: None — catalog auto-seeded (149 indicators). Applied preset-p1 on portfolio and project scopes during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend collection: mongo 'indicator_catalog' (149 docs), 'indicator_selections' (per tenant for project/program/portfolio, per user for dashboard). Field name is 'indicator_id' not 'id'. Projects use 'project_id'. Frontend nav 'Indicateurs' → /catalogue-indicateurs; portfolio has section at bottom; project/program have 'Indicateurs' tab; dashboard has 'Mes indicateurs' section preserving all existing widgets (17 detected).

Dashboard selection is per-user (isolation admin vs pmo)

Frontend catalog page: 149/149 rows, search 'vélocité' → 1 row, expand row shows Formule/Lecture/Données
Frontend portfolio: 11 indicator cards, indicator-detail-modal opens on card click, indicator-selector-modal opens with preset-p1-btn + save-btn
Frontend project detail: project-tabs present, Indicateurs tab clickable, indicators-panel-project renders
Frontend program detail: program-tabs present, indicators-panel-program renders
Frontend dashboard: indicators-panel-dashboard present + 17 existing widget elements retained
